import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from matplotlib.lines import Line2D

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import json
import os
import textwrap

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

def parse_date(d):
    return datetime.strptime(d, '%Y-%m')

tracks_data = {
    'Research':    data['research_milestones']['data'],
    'Industry':    data['industry_milestones']['data'],
    'Regulation':  data['regulation_milestones']['data']
}

invest_raw = data['ai_investment']['data']
invest_years_dt = [datetime(d['year'], 7, 1) for d in invest_raw]
invest_values = np.array([d['investment'] for d in invest_raw])

# ── Design constants ───────────────────────────────────────────
C_RESEARCH   = '#1B4F72'
C_INDUSTRY   = '#922B21'
C_REGULATION = '#1E8449'
C_INVEST_BAR = '#A9CCE3'
C_INVEST_LINE = '#2980B9'
C_CHATGPT    = '#E67E22'
C_ANNOT_BG   = '#FFF8E1'
C_DENSITY    = '#7D3C98'

SIG_SIZES  = {'medium': 70, 'high': 150, 'critical': 280}
SIG_ALPHA  = {'medium': 0.7, 'high': 0.85, 'critical': 1.0}
SIG_LW     = {'medium': 1.0, 'high': 1.5, 'critical': 2.0}

TRACK_Y    = {'Research': 3, 'Industry': 2, 'Regulation': 1}
TRACK_COLOR = {'Research': C_RESEARCH, 'Industry': C_INDUSTRY, 'Regulation': C_REGULATION}

# ── Create figure ──────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(28, 17), facecolor='white')
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 1, height_ratios=[4.2, 1], hspace=0.03,
                       top=0.90, bottom=0.06, left=0.06, right=0.93)

ax_t = fig.add_subplot(gs[0], facecolor='white')
ax_i = fig.add_subplot(gs[1], sharex=ax_t, facecolor='white')

# ── 3-track timeline ───────────────────────────────────────────
# Subtle track bands
for name, y in TRACK_Y.items():
    ax_t.axhspan(y - 0.38, y + 0.38, alpha=0.03, color=TRACK_COLOR[name], zorder=0)

# Track lines
for name, y in TRACK_Y.items():
    ax_t.axhline(y=y, color=TRACK_COLOR[name], linewidth=2.5, alpha=0.45, zorder=1)

# Track labels (right side)
for name, y in TRACK_Y.items():
    ax_t.text(datetime(2025, 2, 15), y, f'  {name}', fontsize=13.5,
              fontweight='bold', color=TRACK_COLOR[name], va='center', ha='left', zorder=10,
              bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.35', facecolor='white',
                        edgecolor=TRACK_COLOR[name], alpha=0.95, linewidth=1.2))

# ── Plot milestones ────────────────────────────────────────────
for track_name, milestones in tracks_data.items():
    y = TRACK_Y[track_name]
    color = TRACK_COLOR[track_name]
    sorted_ms = sorted(milestones, key=lambda x: parse_date(x['date']))

    placed = []
    prev_dt = None
    alt = 0

    for ms in sorted_ms:
        dt = parse_date(ms['date'])
        sig = ms['significance']
        size = SIG_SIZES[sig]
        alpha = SIG_ALPHA[sig]
        lw = SIG_LW[sig]

        # Marker circle
        ax_t.scatter(dt, y, s=size, c=color, alpha=alpha,
                     edgecolors='white', linewidth=lw, zorder=5)

        # Label
        label = ms['label']
        fs = {'medium': 7.2, 'high': 8.2, 'critical': 9.5}.get(sig, 7.5)
        fw = 'bold' if sig == 'critical' else 'normal'

        # Alternate above/below for nearby events
        if prev_dt and (dt - prev_dt).days < 280:
            alt = (alt + 1) % 3

        offsets = [(0.34, 'bottom'), (-0.34, 'top'), (0.58, 'bottom')]
        y_off, va = offsets[alt]

        ax_t.text(dt, y + y_off, label, fontsize=fs, fontweight=fw,
                  color=color, ha='center', va=va, zorder=6)

        prev_dt = dt
        placed.append((dt, y + y_off))

# ── Legend (significance sizes) ─────────────────────────────────
leg_y = 3.85
leg = ax_t.legend(
    handles=[
        Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#666', markersize=7,
               markeredgewidth=0.8, markeredgecolor='white', label='Medium'),
        Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#666', markersize=10,
               markeredgewidth=1.2, markeredgecolor='white', label='High'),
        Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#666', markersize=14,
               markeredgewidth=1.6, markeredgecolor='white', label='Critical'),
    ],
    loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9, fontsize=8.5, title_fontsize=9.5,
    ncol=3, bbox_to_anchor=(0.01, 1.02), edgecolor='#CCC',
    title='Event Significance'
)

# ── ChatGPT inflection ──────────────────────────────────────────
chatgpt_date = datetime(2022, 11, 30)

# Vertical dashed line
ax_t.axvline(x=chatgpt_date, color=C_CHATGPT, linewidth=3,
             linestyle=(0, (8, 4)), alpha=0.7, zorder=4)

# Label
ax_t.annotate(
    'ChatGPT launches\n100M users in 2 months',
    xy=(chatgpt_date, 3.55),
    fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold', color='#935116',
    ha='left', va='top',
    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.5', facecolor=C_ANNOT_BG,
              edgecolor=C_CHATGPT, alpha=0.92, linewidth=1.5),
    zorder=10
)

# Shaded region: 14-month compression window
compress_end = datetime(2024, 2, 1)
ax_t.axvspan(chatgpt_date, compress_end, alpha=0.05, color=C_CHATGPT, zorder=0)

# ── Lag annotations ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Transformer (Research, 2017-06) → ChatGPT (Industry, 2022-11)
trans_dt = datetime(2017, 6, 15)
ax_t.annotate(
    '', xy=(chatgpt_date, TRACK_Y['Industry']),
    xytext=(trans_dt, TRACK_Y['Research']),
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#95A5A6', lw=2.0,
                    connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.25', alpha=0.55),
    zorder=3
)
ax_t.text(datetime(2019, 9, 1), 2.58, '5.4 years\nResearch → Industry',
          fontsize=7.8, color='#7F8C8D', ha='center', fontstyle='italic')

# ChatGPT (Industry, 2022-11) → EU AI Act enacted (Regulation, 2024-03)
eu_dt = datetime(2024, 3, 1)
ax_t.annotate(
    '', xy=(eu_dt, TRACK_Y['Regulation']),
    xytext=(chatgpt_date, TRACK_Y['Industry']),
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#95A5A6', lw=2.0,
                    connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.25', alpha=0.55),
    zorder=3
)
ax_t.text(datetime(2023, 7, 1), 1.35, '1.3 years\nIndustry → Regulation',
          fontsize=7.8, color='#7F8C8D', ha='center', fontstyle='italic')

# ── Density annotation ──────────────────────────────────────────
ax_t.annotate(
    '2023–2024 acceleration:\nMore events across all 3 tracks\nthan in the entire 2010–2017 period',
    xy=(datetime(2024, 1, 15), 3.55),
    fontsize=9.2, fontweight='bold', color=C_DENSITY,
    ha='center', va='bottom',
    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.5', facecolor='#F4ECF7',
              edgecolor=C_DENSITY, alpha=0.90, linewidth=1.2),
    zorder=10
)

# ── 14-month annotation ─────────────────────────────────────────
ax_t.annotate(
    '14-month regulatory surge:\nBiden EO, EU AI Act agreement,\nBletchley Declaration',
    xy=(datetime(2023, 7, 1), 0.45),
    fontsize=8.5, color='#7D6608',
    ha='center', va='top',
    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.45', facecolor='#FFF8E1',

)

# ── Axis styling (timeline) ─────────────────────────────────────
ax_t.set_xlim(datetime(2010, 1, 1), datetime(2025, 6, 30))
ax_t.set_ylim(0.15, 3.85)
ax_t.set_yticks([])
ax_t.spines['top'].set_visible(False)

ax_t.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.12, color='#999')
plt.setp(ax_t.get_xticklabels(), visible=False)

bars = ax_i.bar(invest_years_dt, invest_values, width=bar_w,
                color=C_INVEST_BAR, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)

# Value labels on key bars
for bar, val in zip(bars, invest_values):
    if val >= 40:
        ax_i.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, bar.get_height() + 3.5,
                  f'${val:.0f}B', ha='center', fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold',
                  color='#1B4F72')

# Investment line overlay

fig.suptitle('The AI Revolution: Research, Industry, and Regulation (2010–2025)',
